title: Unique ordinary linear point-restriction transformation
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. For any field k, scheme automorphism g of Spec(k), and coefficient option a (finite exponent n+1 when a=some n, or completed integral coefficients when a=none), use the rings, inverse-image functor F_g, section functor Gamma_a and raw restriction map of [def-trf-point-restriction-coordinates]. There is a unique natural transformation Gamma_a → F_g Gamma_a whose map on every module sheaf M and every final-object section x is exactly pointRestrictionRaw(g,a,M)(x). Its components are linear for the transported coefficient action. No algebraic-closure, boundedness, transition or characteristic hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 00VE and 00WX as used in lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural; the prescribed restriction/insertion construction for the point-transport prerequisite. Agent-formulated ordinary natural-transformation part, before passage to complexes.

proof.text: Use the scalar normalization established in the coordinate proof of [lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural]: restriction of a scalar constant equals the inverse coefficient identification applied to that constant. The module presheaf restriction law then proves that raw restriction is linear for the transported target action. Its additivity is the ordinary additive restriction law. Presheaf-module naturality proves naturality of these linear maps. They are pointRestrictionRaw on every element by construction. Any other transformation with those section values has the same component linear map at every module; module-morphism and natural-transformation extensionality prove uniqueness. This argument works for a=none as well as a=some n, g=id, zero modules and fields not algebraically closed, because no exactness assertion is used.

theorem pointRestrictionSectionTransformation_existsUnique
    (k : Type t) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsIso g] (a : Option ℕ) :
    ∃! σ : pointRestrictionSections l E k a ⟶
        pointRestrictionInverseImage l E g a ⋙ pointRestrictionSections l E k a,
      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)}
          (pointRestrictionRing l E (Spec (.of k)) a))
        (x : M.val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))))),
        σ.app M x = pointRestrictionRaw l E g a M x
